scripts.prepare: bun scripts/build-board.ts && bun scripts/install-hooks.ts && bun scripts/link-spur.ts
scripts.build: bun scripts/bundle-plugins.ts && bun scripts/build-board.ts && bun run --filter './apps/*' --filter './packages/*' build
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=test bun scripts/with-spur-env.ts -- bun test --dots --coverage --coverage-dir=.coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-reporter=text --timeout 20000 --path-ignore-patterns 'vendors/**' apps packages plugins scripts
scripts.test:full: NODE_ENV=test bun scripts/with-spur-env.ts -- bun test --coverage --coverage-dir=.coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-reporter=text apps packages plugins scripts
scripts.test-pre-check: bun scripts/with-spur-env.ts -- spur rule run --preset recommended-pre-check --fail-on warning --no-logo
scripts.test-post-check: bun scripts/with-spur-env.ts -- spur rule run --preset recommended-post-check --fail-on warning --no-logo
scripts.test-pre-check:full: bun scripts/with-spur-env.ts -- spur rule run --preset recommended-pre-check --fail-on warning --no-logo --verbose
scripts.test-post-check:full: bun scripts/with-spur-env.ts -- spur rule run --preset recommended-post-check --fail-on warning --no-logo --verbose
scripts.spur-check: bun run lint && bun run test-pre-check && bun run test && bun run test-post-check
scripts.spur-check:full: bun run lint && bun run test-pre-check:full && bun run test:full && bun run test-post-check:full
scripts.gate: bun run format && bun run build && bun run spur-check
scripts.autofix: bun run format && bun run typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.check:full: bun run lint && bun run test:full
scripts.load-history: DATABASE_URL='.spur/spur.db' spur history import && DATABASE_URL='.spur/spur.db' spur history analyze
